trello.name: Renew and Deploy Wildcard SSL Certificate and Rotate Internal CA Cert
trello.desc: Ben is responsible for renewing and deploying the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com and rotating the internal CA certificate that signs the service mesh. Both certificates expire by September 1st and two weeks after, respectively. The deadline for completion is August 22nd to provide a buffer. Ben also needs to move both certificates onto cert-manager to set up auto-renewal to prevent manual renewal yearly.

trello.name: Implement PDF Export Feature for Reports with Demo GIF
trello.desc: Aisha is to develop the PDF export feature for reports by the end of the month. This includes both backend rendering of reports to PDF using headless Chrome and frontend implementation of the export button with progress state indicators. Additionally, Aisha will record a short demo GIF of the feature for marketing to use in the changelog as part of the feature delivery.

trello.name: Ensure Staging Environment Parity with Production
trello.desc: Ben will address staging environment drift by running the three pending migrations today to bring staging up to date with production. Additionally, he will write and deploy a nightly job to compare the staging schema against production and post any divergences to the infrastructure channel to maintain parity.
